scope: Engineering candidate screen; all gates are conjunctive; validation is development only
signed_gain_definition: sum(prediction*truth)/sum(truth^2), pooled across the two continuum variants within each mother and signed peak; eight non-null groups, each two frames/131072 pixels
weak_group_RMSE: each mother x +/-30 group no worse than hybrid003 at the same group
null_frame_RMSE: each of four null frames no worse than hybrid003 on that frame
temperature: bitwise identical to previous cached temperature on all20validationframes
success: Every gate passes. Retain only an engineering candidate; no scientific acceptance or detector false-positive claim.
failure_stop: Retain checkpoint and all diagnostics, no additional training sweep. Three unallocated calls remain; preserve the 9448-call required science plan.
null_meaning: Null template RMS is an uncalibrated residual proxy, not detector false-positive rate.
